BT_OUT.SECTION_DESC: Stream Volumio playback to a Bluetooth speaker or amplifier. ⚠️ IMPORTANT, to avoid losing sound: 1) Stop playback before switching devices on this page or before powering off the speaker/amp. 2) If there is no sound after switching devices, reboot Volumio (Settings -> System -> Reboot). 3) After a reboot, wait ~15 seconds before pressing play, or the first track may stutter. How to use: click 'Scan for devices', wait ~10 seconds, close and re-open this settings page, pick your device from the list below, enable the toggle and press Save.
BT_OUT.SCAN_DOC: Looks for nearby Bluetooth devices (~8s). Close and re-open this settings page afterwards to see them in the device list below.
BT_OUT.ENABLE_DOC: Pairs/connects to the selected device and adds it as an MPD output alongside your normal output.
BT_OUT.MAC_DOC: Pick a discovered device. If pairing requires a PIN on the device itself, confirm it there when prompted.
BT_OUT.NAME: Device name
BT_OUT.NAME_DOC: Filled in automatically from the selected device.
